c05-dmso-overlap: Human Medium (47 words): It overlaps with aged ozonated-charcoal water, but the two don't always work equally. Sometimes DMSO calms a trip better, and sometimes the charcoal water does. I don't yet know why. In my experience there is generally no harm in taking both or mixing them.
Human Low (19 words): Ozonated-charcoal water has what I consider a perfect safety profile; DMSO is a close second in my experience.
c17-opposites: Human Medium (15 words): In the subconscious world of concepts, though, each idea often comes paired with its opposite.
